title: QuantumVault Threat Model
system_description: Compromise-resilient post-quantum security platform enforcing access invariants across key changes, lost devices, process crashes, and network partitions.

assets.name: Confidential Business Content
assets.protection_mechanism: AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption with 96-bit CSPRNG nonces and Additional Authenticated Data (AAD) binding asset_id:owner_id

assets.name: Master & Versioned Cryptographic Keys
assets.protection_mechanism: Key Encryption Key (KEK) wrapping, memory zeroization, and 4-state lifecycle machine (pre_active, active, grace_period, retired)

assets.name: Device & Identity Credentials
assets.protection_mechanism: NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 and Ed25519 digital signature verification, single-use recovery credentials, and cryptographic challenge-response authentication

assets.name: Authoritative Policy & Cluster Epochs
assets.protection_mechanism: Monotonic cluster epoch tracking, Security Authority durable SQLite commits, external disk epoch anchor, and HMAC-SHA256 authenticated IPC broadcasts

assets.name: Tamper-Evident Audit Trail
assets.protection_mechanism: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining, genesis zero-hash initialization, signed external checkpoints, and CWE-117 log injection neutralization

trust_boundaries.name: Untrusted Client / Evaluator Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Standard input/output JSON pipe and HTTP API endpoints. All inputs parsed via strict JSON schema, bounds-checked, and subject to FIPS 203 canonicality validation.

trust_boundaries.name: Node-to-Authority IPC Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Inter-node communication between Security Authority and Node A, Node B, Node C. All messages signed with HMAC-SHA256, bound to target node ID, and checked against replay caches.

trust_boundaries.name: Durable Storage Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: SQLite 3 file on local disk with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) and atomic transactions. Sensitive columns encrypted with AES-256-GCM.

adversaries.name: Lost or Compromised Device Attacker
adversaries.threat_description: Adversary gains physical or digital control of a registered client device and submits read requests.
adversaries.security_invariant: Immediate revocation broadcast enforces rejection on all reachable nodes within 9.59 ms median; anti-resurrection guarantees persistent denial across process crashes and restarts.

adversaries.name: Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later Quantum Adversary
adversaries.threat_description: Passive eavesdropper records encrypted communications to perform offline decryption once cryptanalytically relevant quantum computers exist.
adversaries.security_invariant: Ephemeral NIST FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 key encapsulation guarantees post-quantum forward secrecy against Shor's algorithm.

adversaries.name: Storage Snapshot & Ciphertext Swap Attacker
adversaries.threat_description: Adversary gains access to SQLite database file or backup archives and attempts to read plaintext or swap ciphertexts across owners.
adversaries.security_invariant: AES-256-GCM with AAD formatted as 'asset_id:owner_id' prevents cross-owner and same-owner ciphertext swapping; encrypted backups prevent plaintext disclosure.

adversaries.name: Network Partitioner & Man-in-the-Middle
adversaries.threat_description: Network disruption isolates a service node or delays revocation broadcasts.
adversaries.security_invariant: Nodes enforce a 5.0-second heartbeat threshold; stale or partitioned nodes immediately fail closed (decision: deny). Stale epochs are rejected upon reconnection.

adversaries.name: Backup Rollback Attacker
adversaries.threat_description: Adversary restores an older valid database backup to resurrect revoked actors or consumed recovery credentials.
adversaries.security_invariant: BackupRestoreManager verifies the backup's cluster epoch against the external disk anchor epoch_anchor.txt; older epochs are rejected as rollback attacks.

adversaries.name: Audit Log Tamperer / Log Injector
adversaries.threat_description: Adversary attempts to modify past audit decisions, delete audit rows, or inject phantom log lines using CRLF characters.
adversaries.security_invariant: SHA-256 hash chaining detects any row alteration or deletion; CWE-117 sanitization neutralizes newline log injection attacks.

assumptions_and_limitations.limitation: The system supports timestamp offsets up to +/-1 hour via source offset correction; unannounced physical clock drift is buffered up to 10.0 seconds.
Session resumption is intentionally omitted to maintain strict forward secrecy across lost device events.
Inter-node cluster IPC operates over authenticated local pipes; WAN deployment requires mutual TLS (mTLS).
